add.req: Recessed ice maker outlet box in the wall behind the sink base back panel (access cutout): 1/4-turn valve, 1/4" compression outlet, water hammer arrestor; fed from the sink CW (P2) BEFORE the RO. From it ONE continuous 1/4" OD line (soft copper, or 3/8" PEX with 1/4" compression adapters at both ends), no joints under the floor: down through the floor (sleeved), across the tech room (supported; insulated if unheated), up into the freezer niche to W1. No saddle valve. Pressure 29-116 psi (2-8 bar). Pressure-test before the columns go in.
add.src: Andriy 2026-10-16; recon-2026-10-16-7612-icemaker-led; Thermador T24IF905SP Spec Book p.2 (zone B, accessible waterbox), Use & Care p.9

add.req: 120 V 15 A duplex, SWITCHED by S1 (switch loop), on the back panel of the sink base, left. The LED driver (per Cesar) sits in the sink base and plugs in here; low-voltage Class 2 cable from it to L1 / L2. Not behind the toe kick: the kick is only 60 mm (2 3/8").

1/4" OD line from the ice maker box P6 at the sink, up through the floor in the freezer niche, zone B (side away from the power, ~4" in): capped 1/4" compression (7/16"-24 M) for the appliance hose (4 ft, supplied). NO valve in the niche - the shut-off is P6, serviceable without pulling the column. Connect the hose not earlier than 1 h after the column is set.
